- New mini APK, the safe build (lite stays as it was: the full app without Pulse AI): no root or Shizuku, no SMS / MMS, no accessibility services (App lock, auto clicker, cache cleaner, cover, App watch, keyboard helper), no APK installs (ArtCraft, in-app updates), no call log and no secure settings. App scanners read that set of rights as a banking trojan; the full app keeps every tool. In mini every launcher entry is named "Pulse …" (Pulse Messages, Pulse Files, Pulse Store …) and the widgets carry no other company's name (Classic, Luna, Aero, Rounded instead of Windows and iOS): one app with some thirty entries named like system apps was flagged as a "FakeApp".
